scope: root independent XML audit; no coordinates retained; coarse compass is not a glyph shape judgment

method.orderedTrack: Fetched the official inline XML again and parsed x/y attributes independently of their attribute order. Every one of the 63 Track units has at least two MoveTo points. This is an independent root audit of directional order, not an original-coordinate dataset.
method.compass: N means up on screen; compass labels are coarse summaries of nonzero segments. Repeated direction labels are omitted, so these strings cannot reconstruct a path.
method.visualCrosscheck: Root directly viewed all five full numbered Moyaland diagrams in RAM. Agents separately viewed fresh MOE slow playback and publisher PDF rows.
method.directionBoundary: Moyaland numbering and Dongyang cumulative shapes establish static correspondence only. Observed motion and ordered Track establish direction under the Taiwan MOE standard.
method.existingPolicy: The existing document pipeline permits Korean publisher cumulative-order evidence with separately reviewed official direction evidence. Direct Korean motion is not a new prerequisite.
method.geometryBoundary: Official XML and source images remain RAM-only. No official coordinates or source media are included in candidate paths or runtime output.

rootFindings.observation: Domestic diagram has a long right-falling stroke; MOE has a short right-falling dot. Shared direction does not establish shared shape.
Domestic sequence uses center vertical, left dot, right dot; MOE uses left dot, center dot, right dot. The 4–6 cluster requires explicit per-stroke conflict classification.
Domestic full numbering and MOE ordered motion both use upper horizontal, second horizontal, vertical, lower horizontal.
